findings.title: Accountability held behind an appointed boundary
findings.claim: Within the host pericope, the focus's mercy does not cancel accountability: what is acquired remains tied to being taken to account, immediate punishment is held back, and the appointed time leaves no refuge beyond it.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries protective forgiveness, tender mercy, accountable seizure, acquired deeds, acceleration, punishment, appointment, and refuge. The 18:48 presentation, 18:49 present record, 18:53 unavailable diversion, and 18:57 sent-ahead deeds supply independent contacts that turn the conditional acceleration into a governed interval ending at a real boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: Delay becomes an active relation between what has been earned and when it is exposed, rather than an empty pause or disappearance of consequence.
findings.containment: The finding does not claim that every pericope scene is one undifferentiated event, nor that punishment is already occurring; the cited surrounding scenes are contextual contacts that keep the focus's primary mercy-and-appointment statement recoverable.

findings.title: The reprieve as a warned opportunity
findings.claim: The delay before the focus appointment is filled with warnings, reminders, forgiveness-seeking, and an account that can still grow while receptivity can close; it is an opportunity whose use is exposed by refusal.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the focus forgiveness predicate and acquired-deed relation to the supplied 18:54-57 sequence: disputation can deflect examples, forgiveness remains sought, warning and reminder arrive, deeds are sent ahead, and a covering obstructs understanding. The context therefore gives content to the interval before the appointment.
findings.reader_payoff: Merciful non-hastening becomes active time for response, with both repair and hardening visible before the boundary.
findings.containment: The HFT reader inference remains qualified: the same sequence can be read as a diagnosis of refusal without making a complete theological purpose for delay. The 18:54 connection is retained as limited counterevidence rather than suppressed.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic and word-indexed HFT traces are supplied, but contextual branch identities are unresolved and the source explicitly offers an alternative account of what the sequence defines.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus forgiveness predicate carries a possible protective interval before punishment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied forgiveness-seeking and warning occurrences give separate repair and notice contacts.
branch_activations.activation: Forgiveness contacts request and warning, making the delayed appointment a period in which response remains possible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reprieve can hold open an opportunity for repair before consequence.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT trace does not establish that this opportunity guarantees forgiveness or acceptance.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The interval exposes refusal as an active use of the time before the appointment.
branch_activations.boundary: The 18:54 connection is not treated as a complete definition of mercy or as stronger than the supplied qualification.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reprieve contains notice that can still be received or refused.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the warning has one exclusive rhetorical form.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The warned opportunity can be consumed by a settled failure to understand.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that forgiveness causes incomprehension or that the two roots are synonyms.

findings.title: A fixed horizon beyond the reprieve
findings.claim: The focus's merciful delay retains a fixed horizon that the immediate sequel applies to communal destruction: consequence is not hastened, but neither is its appointed boundary removed.
findings.mechanism: The focus appointment is carried into 18:59, where the supplied ruin occurrence is explicitly assigned its own appointment. The repeated time relation contacts the focus's non-acceleration and gives the waiting period a realized communal analogue.
findings.reader_payoff: Mercy and consequence no longer appear as opposites; mercy governs timing while the horizon remains structurally present.
findings.containment: The attributed inference treats 18:59 as a contextual analogy, not proof that the focus subjects and the destroyed towns share one event or one complete timetable.

epistemic.reason: The focus and sequel Arabic are supplied and the HFT trace is exact, but the communal extension remains an attributed inference with an explicit alternative boundary.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus appointment carries the fixed temporal horizon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The sequel repeats an appointment for the destruction of towns.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated appointment contacts the focus's delayed consequence, extending the bounded-time relation to a communal scene.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus reprieve is a delay before a horizon that can be realized at communal scale.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT trace does not resolve whether the sequel defines the focus appointment or offers an analogy.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied sequel occurrence carries ruin and destruction as the realized endpoint of wrongdoing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The sequel appointment and the focus appointment supply the two temporal contacts.
branch_activations.activation: Ruin contacts the repeated appointment and the focus's fixed horizon, showing consequence after reprieve without immediate acceleration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: An appointed communal collapse can follow a real period of mercy and delay.
branch_activations.boundary: The context does not establish that every focus subject reaches communal ruin or that the focus appointment is identical to 18:59's appointment.

findings.title: Two directions of covering
findings.claim: The focus's protective forgiveness and the preceding heart-cover form a contrastive covering topology: one shields from immediate effect, while the other shields settled refusal from corrective understanding.
findings.mechanism: The attributed HFT trace places the focus forgiveness carrier against the exact 18:57 heart-cover occurrence and its inability-to-understand setting. The shared covering image changes the focus by making protection structurally ambivalent without equating the roots or making forgiveness cause incomprehension.
findings.reader_payoff: Covering becomes visible in two directions, so the focus's mercy can be felt as protection from immediate consequence while the surrounding warning can also describe protection from understanding.
findings.containment: This is a bounded contrastive mechanism, not a synonym claim about the two roots, not a causal claim that forgiveness produces incomprehension, and not a ranking of the two readings.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchor, word indices, and HFT outlier trace are supplied, but the contextual branch remains unresolved and the relation is explicitly marked as surprising and attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus forgiveness predicate carries a protective covering relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied heart-cover occurrence supplies the contrasting cover over understanding.
branch_activations.activation: The two covering occurrences meet through the focus return: protection from immediate effect is set beside obstruction of corrective perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Covering can preserve from consequence or preserve from comprehension, depending on the contact supplied by the pericope.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT record does not authorize a gloss for the focus branch beyond this attributed covering relation.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied heart-cover occurrence carries obstruction of understanding after reminder.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus forgiveness carrier supplies the contrasting protective direction.
branch_activations.activation: The heart cover contacts the focus covering relation through the difference between corrective protection and corrective obstruction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The context makes the focus's protective covering newly perceptible as one pole of a contrast, not as erasure.
branch_activations.boundary: No root identity, synonymy, or causal relation beyond the shared topology is claimed.

friction_notes: The six legacy-unbound HFT findings retain exact supplied ayah, word-index, root, role, and focus-return traces, but their branch glosses and facets remain unresolved and are therefore marked attributed.
The 18:54 connection carries reciprocal no-value counterevidence; it is preserved in the warned-interval finding's containment rather than treated as a decision or silently discarded.

The automatic host basmala 18:0 and explicitly added external ayat 1:2-1:7 were reviewed under the macro phase boundary. Their available root cues did not supply an independent local carrier-trigger-contact-change-payoff-boundary relation to 18:58, so no external overlay finding is retained.
